decisions.title: OS固有契約と任意executable
decisions.proposal: Packageの任意apt/dnf/pkg、journald sink、任意Plugin/provider executable、OS shell依存機能は、署名付きcapabilityとrouterdの管理面へ明示的に置換する案。未対応を拒否するだけでは旧契約全体のparityにならない。各inputごとに移行policy・理由・代替・受入を記録する。

decisions.title: 単一配布イメージと展開済み多binary runtime
decisions.proposal: 配布イメージは対象architecture/profileごとに一つとし、filesystemへ展開した複数binary/library/plugin/dataの束をruntime environmentにする。native moduleも独立binaryへ分割でき、二つのELFに固定しない。manifest digestでruntime全体を選択・固定・復旧し、個別componentの互換未確認な混在を許さない。

decisions.title: kernel書換権限
decisions.proposal: network writerへのbrokerを優先する。engineが直接XFRM等を管理する必要がある場合は、object namespace/owner/reconcile/foreign-state保護を限定した委譲ADRを先に合格させる。一般route/firewallの二重writerを黙認しない。

decisions.title: 旧動作互換とnativeの改善
decisions.proposal: BFD bootstrap/reset、health鮮度、IPv6 known-good rule、sticky、DNS finite ownership等は、legacy互換modeと明示replacementを分ける。現在のnative defaultsへ直接写して同等と数えない。

decisions.title: HAと移行方式
decisions.proposal: RouterdClusterはfile/flock/TTLの旧契約を基準にする。新旧node混在によるrolling migrationか、検証済みsnapshotを伴うmaintenance切替かを決め、選択した方式を二台で受入する。

decisions.title: 基準機能と追加配備先
decisions.proposal: baselineのIPv4 /32 SAMとAWS/Azure/Oracle Cloud executorをまず復元する。GCPの具体的adapter、Golden Images、K8s運用は個別にqualificationする。EVPN、独自CNI、FreeBSD portは今回のbaseline完了条件に追加しない。

decisions.title: engine版・license・配布資料
decisions.proposal: OS package名だけでなく正確なsource/build flags/dependencies/enabled componentsを固定する。nDPIの現在のcomponent別条件を確認し、process分離をlicense上の結論として扱わない。

decisions.title: boot config → runtime → startup-config
decisions.proposal: イメージの検証・展開、次回runtime選択、起動を分ける。小さなboot層はruntimeとstartup-configの参照を選び、選択runtimeが設定schemaを検証・適用する。設定journalとYAMLを独立した正本にせず、boot attemptの可変状態も設定意図と分離する。最初の実装方式はverified runtimeへのexecによるPID 1引継ぎを推奨する。

decisions.title: 未リリース routerd2 の形式互換は不要
decisions.proposal: routerdは稼働中の機能参照元、routerd2は未リリースの別製品。routerd2の二binary形式、manifest、boot schema、設定書式、journal、内部APIは破壊的に置換でき、互換reader・v1 bridge・prototype state移行は作らない。routerdから引き継ぐ機能の範囲は減らさず、routerd2の製品版間更新/復旧保証は初回リリースの新形式を基準に始める。

implementation_notes.implemented: One coordinator owns kernel application, worker reconciliation and application ACKs against actual supervisor registration. Each accepted source prepares immutable protocol worker configs, canonical child-file bytes and digests once outside the observation mutex, including conditionally inactive and generated RA workers. Ordinary projections select these definitions; BGP/VRRP typed configs and static LAN RA templates are reused. Cutover selects matching live observations without rebuilding identities. Dynamic RA prefix/lifetime/DNS data stays outside immutable worker config. Finite readiness and original protocol deadlines still bound kernel resources and consumers. No extra manager, invalidation flag, synthetic producer, receipt lease or prototype adapter was added. Worker ABI is 5; the current compiler contract is native-29 and network ownership journal is format 10. Protocol network projection now owns only the collections it changes and shares fixed intent read-only, removing its JSON round-trip copy. DHCPv6/RA/AFTR now carry original deadlines, remove DHCPv6 receipt grants and AFTR rebase/anchor state, and support explicit current-boot infinity for addresses. DS-Lite-specific kernel/journal paths are removed. Ordinary ip6tnl links retain original AFTR deadlines, and the writer independently fences links and withdraws dependent managed addresses/routes while control is frozen. Readiness reports ordinary pending observation/kernel application as applying, while confirmation still refuses unapplied observations; actual failures remain degraded. Operator service restart now shares the compiled dependency drain and coordinator with configuration replacement; direct supervisor restart of dynamic services is removed. Restart does not change operator revision; acceptance acknowledges drain and restart request, not protocol acquisition. A staged DHCPv6 retirement never completes the caller WAN drain: reaping the child between pre-prepare and post-prepare status reads must advance another pass against the original stop target. Graceful operator control restart now uses the supervisor-owned drain: keep the old coordinator and WAN through DHCPv6 withdrawal/application/Release, reap other dynamic workers, replace control, retire old producers, then instantiate configured workers. Network/management/logging remain alive. Status uses one Lifecycle contract (running/restarting_control/stopping), with worker ABI5 and no old stopping-field adapter.
implementation_notes.validation: Worker-file bytes match supervisor digests. The worker-preparation change in 61a2918 passed the six BFD/BGP cases and reduced static projection plus selection for eight BGP routers/64 peers each from median 2.531 ms/540004 bytes/1238 allocations to 7.756 us/4021 bytes/20 allocations; this is not packet throughput or learned-RIB performance. The current projection-ownership build passed local source/earlier-projection immutability during RA withdrawal and address/route expiry, full make check (Race Detector and vet), and static amd64/arm64 builds. Actual two-WAN Health/PBR, PD/RA renewal/renumber/expiry/reacquisition with routed TCP/UDP, AFTR, IPv6 VRF BFD/BGP and Keepalived Health tracking passed with the current binaries. The six-ELF signed bundle/catalog/publisher checks passed. Output paths are in docs/pve-codex-handoff.md. arm64 was not executed. wan-retirement: reproduced ca0b9bd actual persistent appliance accepting restart while keeping PPP generation1 and restarting only PD generation2. Deterministic status-read interleaving failed before the fix and now waits for WAN retirement. Final APK/Linux6.18.58-lts with independent AC/ISC and separate Linux LAN passed actual PPP generation/interface replacement, RA/Release/Reply/PADT order and both-family TCP/UDP/DNS, plus explicit ext4 persistent reboot/second boot, committed revision/MTU, DUID and pinned SSH key, then clean poweroff. Full Go/Python/Race/vet/static builds passed. control-drain/native28/workerABI5: independent RP-PPPoE/ISC plus separate Linux LAN passed native signed PID1 and APK/Linux6.18.58-lts factory control replacement with old-PD Release before PPP/control replacement, stable network/management PIDs, revision and DUID, new control/PPP/PD, both-family TCP/UDP and UDP/TCP DNS recovery, and stale old-producer HTTP409. Captures confirmed zero-lifetime RA, Release, matching Reply, then PADT. Factory poweroff passed with kernel Power down/QEMU exit0. Final reboot peer output confirmed second kernel/PID1 with persistent ext4 revision2/MTU1400/DUID/pinned SSH key and restored communication; the expired PTY exit code was not re-observed. First post-fix factory run failed when ISC bound before the new AC PPP interface existed; fixture now waits for the actual new AC ifindex before binding, without traffic retries or longer budgets. make check/build-linux/image passed. make check-health-pbr passed actual two-WAN TCP/UDP failure/recovery, Health/control/network replacement, stale/expired observations, writer fencing and confirmed rollback with unchanged intended outcomes. Final six-ELF signed catalog/publisher/stage tests passed with Race Detector; arm64 execution remains untested.
remaining: The historical BFD reconnection timeout still lacks direct failed-request diagnostics. IPv6 multicast now has independent Keepalived VIP TCP/UDP and wire checks, but the earlier bridged missing-advertisement cause remains unresolved. The initial IPv6 unicast TCP timeout with election-authority expiry was reproduced once on current products; syscall tracing did not reproduce it. Request-time snapshots were added to failure diagnostics; neither client deadlines nor election authority were extended.

Keep other accepted protocol data typed, compile static condition work and remove the remaining writer snapshot JSON round-trip copying. DHCP client allocation and durable retention still depend on UTC; these changes do not qualify allocation across wall-clock correction, power loss or physical suspend.

Expiry while the network writer itself is unavailable and physical suspend remain unqualified. Recursive prerequisite address/link deadline propagation has local projection checks; equivalent paused-control real-daemon cases are not yet exercised.

Under simultaneous Go checks, the 7000-route large-ACK test exceeded its 30-second confirmed budget and confirm returned 409. Normal make check passed the same control package and full race suite. No authority or test deadlines were extended; load acceptance and cause isolation remain open.

implementation_notes.implemented: egress-route/native-46 adds one typed egress_route owning destination/table/metric. Highest currently true candidate preference wins; equal preference candidates share existing kernel weighted ECMP. Existing finite fact/hold evaluation supplies eligibility and original authority; no new worker, mutable selection cache or compatibility path.
